component: Persistent bottom bar plus an inline copy of the same page turn controls
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (education.md E4). Observed: Previous and Next appeared inline and in the bottom bar, and at 820 the inline pair sat flush against the screen edges with no gutter. Fix: one set of page turn controls per breakpoint. This is a failure to apply the meta principle (remove before adding) and P18 (mobile breathing room), and P10 (do not show every action at once). Application specific; it generalizes only as an anti-pattern about duplicated controls.

classification.rationale: Failure to apply P10 and the meta principle; fixed in the application. Could be folded into the repeated controls anti-pattern candidate (FB-0032). Suggestion only.
